//
//  ScrollingCaptureStitcher.swift
//  Snapzy
//
//  Vertical stitcher for scrolling capture sessions.
//
changes: Ticket 04: prepend complete BSD-3 licence and retain banner; replace unused AppKit import with CoreGraphics; add conservative exact settled-partial-step fallback.
Ticket 05: previous-accepted-frame matching, lossless 256-row compressed strips, independent lazy image provider, bounded autorelease scopes, exact sticky-band boundaries.
Ticket 34: move into FrisketCore as internal implementation of the pure Stitcher sequence interface; replace strip decode assertion with typed imageUnavailable error to satisfy closed diagnostics.
